recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: The harm-forward head scores BELOW the z(t-1) persistence predictor in 6/6 cells (skill -71.7 to -1.2), with residual RMS 1.5-8.5x the true per-step displacement of z_harm_a, so the dACC harm-PE that MECH-055 axis 3 routes on is dominated by model error rather than world surprise. CAUSE NOT ESTABLISHED between under-training / train-eval mismatch and a representation ceiling -- see the fan-out.
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: Three separable pieces, cheapest first. (1) INSTRUMENT, owed on every branch and not gated on the discrimination: the readiness gate harm_a_forward_r2_supra_floor is an absolute R2 floor (FORWARD_R2_MIN = 0.30, in the DRIVER at v3_exq_1062a_...postshift.py:496, not in ree_core) with no baseline; it passed at 0.9405 while the trivial predictor scores 0.9955. Gate on skill-vs-persistence, computed on the same r2_pairs at zero extra cost. This is an experiments/_lib or driver change, not a ree_core one. (2) RECORDING, also cheap: the manifest carries NO training-loss trajectory for e2_harm_a, so convergence cannot be checked from the artifact at all -- record it (Experimental Recording Standard section 3b/3c). (3) Only then the SUBSTRATE question, which the fan-out splits: is the head under-trained (60 eps x 90 steps online at batch 1, lr 5e-4, no P2 training, P1 epsilon 0.1 vs P2 epsilon 0.0), or is there a representation ceiling? NOTE the arithmetic that motivates this ordering: a displacement ceiling on a RESIDUAL head predicts delta -> 0 and skill ~ 0, because the conditional-mean delta is in the hypothesis space at the MSE optimum. Skill of -72 is not a ceiling signature -- it requires the head to be ACTIVELY adding error, i.e. non-convergence, distribution mismatch, or overfitting.

failure_record_entry.metric: harm_forward_skill_vs_persistence NEGATIVE in 6/6 cells (stationary -71.67/-3.98/-23.48, shift -5.99/-2.28/-1.16). Residual-to-displacement ratio (1-r2)/(1-persistence_r2) = 72.7/5.0/24.5 stationary, 7.0/3.3/2.2 shift -- the model's residual RMS is 1.5-8.5x the latent's true per-step displacement. harm_a_forward_r2 0.9405-0.9773 passed its 0.30 readiness floor in every cell while being BELOW the trivial baseline (persistence_r2 0.9693-0.9993). harm_forward_action_sensitivity 0.46-1.19 above its 0.05 floor, so the head is NOT action-blind -- though that statistic is normalised by the model's OWN predicted delta, which is itself 1.5-8.5x too large, so it means 'the action moves a wrong delta by 46-119% of its wrong size'. CAVEAT ON MAGNITUDE: skill is denominator-driven -- 1-persistence_r2 spans 0.00073 to 0.01194 (16.4x) across three seeds at an identical config, so -71.7 is a seed whose latent barely moved, not a 72x-worse model. The robust statement is the SIGN, 6/6. NO TRAINING-LOSS TRAJECTORY for e2_harm_a is recorded, so convergence cannot be checked from this manifest.
failure_record_entry.target: harm_forward_skill_vs_persistence > 0 on >= 2/3 seeds on the stationary arm, ON A HEAD WHOSE TRAINING CURVE IS RECORDED and evaluated at matched epsilon. Plus a readiness precondition that gates on that skill rather than on an absolute R2 floor.

fanout_recommendation.note: GOV-FANOUT-1: four rivals on four different axes. The single-unambiguous-build exemption is NOT claimed. Ordering matters and was corrected at the red-team pass: the under-training leg is cheapest and is the one the arithmetic favours, so the substrate build must not be commissioned ahead of it. The instrument fix (a skill-vs-persistence readiness floor) and the recording fix (an e2_harm_a training curve) are owed on ALL FOUR branches and are gated on none of them.

learning_extracted: The persistence baseline V3-EXQ-1062's autopsy prescribed as instrument (2) fired, and its result forecloses that autopsy's own conditional step (3): 'only then ladder the dose -- and only if (1)+(2) show the residual can move at all'. Instrument (2) reports the head does not beat a trivial predictor in any cell. No dose ladder is owed and none should be queued.

The onset fix is verified in the cells, not merely asserted: n_world_rule_shifts_before_p2 = 0 in all 6 cells against ~810 in V3-EXQ-1062, action_map_canonical_at_p2_onset true everywhere, 180 P2 shifts per shift cell. V3-EXQ-1062's confound is gone, which is what makes this run's H2 test the first clean one.

H2 is PARTIALLY SUPPORTED on 2/3 seeds -- corrected at the red-team pass, where an earlier draft read it as 'the predicted divergence did not appear'. Read on the RAW r2 gap (0.0315 mean) that reading looks right; read on UNEXPLAINED VARIANCE it does not. 1-r2 goes 0.0528 -> 0.1042 (1.97x) on seed 42 and 0.0227 -> 0.0664 (2.93x) on seed 2026, with seed 137 flat at 0.99x. The lever DOES reach the harm-forward model's residual on two of three seeds. What fails is the dACC PE MAGNITUDE floor (+2.4% pooled vs +5.0%). No pre-registered threshold existed for the gap itself, so this is a directional read, not a verdict.

The onset fix HELPED but not enough, and the direction is worth recording: pe_load_elevated_vs_stationary moved from -0.0332 (V3-EXQ-1062, wrong sign) to +0.0242 (this run, right sign, still under the 0.05 floor). Exposure was unmoved -- 3.282 vs 3.276 against a 0.25 ceiling, i.e. ~4.28x in both runs -- so the exposure confound is a property of the lever, not of the schedule.

A WINDOWED successor is foreclosed too, by the driver's own non-gating early-window copies: over the first 300 P2 steps harm_exposure_rel_dev_early is 1.804 (still above the 0.25 ceiling) and pe_elevation_early is 0.0132 (still below the 0.05 floor). A shorter measurement window does NOT clear the pre-registered bars without moving them, which is exactly the question those instruments were recorded to answer.

SHARPER MECHANISM than H3 as worded: the head IS action-sensitive (0.46-1.19) yet permuting the true action->displacement map 180 times barely moves its R2 (paired per-seed gap +0.051/-0.0005/+0.044). So its action-dependence is DECORRELATED from the true map -- the error was never derived from the map, which is why no permutation dose can raise it. That is a different substrate defect from 'the head ignores the action', and it is what the fan-out legs must discriminate.

H3 SPLITS. Its consequence -- the head does not beat persistence -- is confirmed in 6/6 cells. The mechanism ELIMINATED is the one the 1062a DRIVER stated (a delta driven toward zero, i.e. an action-BLIND head; drv62a:100-105), NOT the V3-EXQ-1062 autopsy's wording, which said only 'persistence-dominated ... no action-map lever at any dose can raise its residual' and named no delta->0 mechanism. Attribution corrected at the red-team pass. Action sensitivity is 0.46-1.19, above its floor -- but normalised by the model's own oversized delta, so it should not be quoted as evidence the head reads the action CORRECTLY.

NEGATIVE-INSTRUMENT FINDING (CLAUDE.md doctrine): harm_a_forward_r2_supra_floor is a readiness gate with no baseline. It exists to guarantee axis 3 is a forward-model residual rather than a LEVEL, and it cannot see the third case -- a residual dominated by model error. It graded 0.9405 ready against a 0.30 floor while the trivial predictor scored 0.9955. This retro-weakens the Prerequisites='present' row of the V3-EXQ-1062 autopsy, which rested on exactly that figure.

Cross-target with V3-EXQ-1075: TWO OBSERVATIONS OF THE SAME SHAPE, NOT ONE MECHANISM -- softened at the red-team pass. Both heads are residual (z + delta) and both baselines are copy-the-input, so the form is comparable. But on the world head the result is operating-point dependent -- V3-EXQ-1073 measured skill -0.071/+0.227/-0.007 on the SAME head at the same P0/LR, i.e. seed 123 BEAT identity -- while V3-EXQ-1075's OFF arm measured -5.8/-2.2/-8.4 with the cause unidentified. On the harm head the sign is robust 6/6 but the magnitude is denominator-driven and convergence is unrecorded. Different latents, different training regimes, different baseline meanings. Do not cite this as a single substrate law.

MAGNITUDE CAVEAT, and it matters for how this is cited: skill-vs-persistence is denominator-driven. 1-persistence_r2 spans 0.00073 to 0.01194 -- a 16.4x spread across three seeds at an IDENTICAL config -- so -71.7 is a seed whose latent happened to move very little, not a 72x-worse model. The robust claim is the SIGN (negative in 6/6), not the magnitude.

RECORDING GAP (distinct from a measurement gap, and the cheaper fix): the manifest carries no training-loss trajectory for e2_harm_a, so whether the head converged at all cannot be checked from the artifact. That is exactly the recording-debt category -- the readout existed at run time and was not durably written -- and it is what makes the under-training vs representation-ceiling discrimination need a new run rather than a re-read. Cite the Experimental Recording Standard (evidence/planning/experimental_recording_standard_2026-07-12.md) in the successor spec.
